name: Seed Junky Pre-Roll | Caffeine
description: Caffeine doesn't just wake you up, it electrifies your mind and flips the switch to hyper drive. Bright and fluffy, it delivers a blast of sweet candy, like Fun Dip and Sweet Tarts, layered with tropical citrus, creamy lime, and a heavy gas finish that keeps the flavor loud all the way through. This strain doesn't creep. It hits fast and hard, launching you into a wired head high that feels electric, focused, and creatively charged. Perfect for idea sprints, deep doves, or getting way too into your to-do list, Caffeine keeps your mind moving and your senses lit.
